gen-gf-gugi-gf-carrois-gothic: Bold, distinctive Gugi stands tall, its lowercase nearly reaching the capitals and its terminals cut open. Carrois Gothic follows in a plain sans with a high x-height, so give its text a little extra size and it settles in comfortably.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: Sharp, rod-like and showy: Gugi draws every glyph with a single-width stroke and tall lowercase. Carrois Gothic SC sits next to it feeling friendly and contemporary, with open curve endings and capitals barely taller than its lowercase.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-chivo: Approachable Chivo is the quieter half here, but Gugi supplies the swagger. Chivo does its best work in running text, with daylight through every curve, while Gugi's tall lowercase and open-cut terminals do theirs up front in the headline.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-chocolate-classical-sans: Rounded rods, stamped bold. Gugi holds one width throughout, and Chocolate Classical Sans, a plain sans with a broad-nibbed stroke, would only crowd it if the heading shrank or the body grew large.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-comme: Modern Comme reads smoothly, its lowercase bodies filling most of the letter height with no clogged curves. And Gugi, with no calligraphic swell on any downstroke, gives the pair its strongest quality: a sharp, uniform-stroke heading above a plain sans body.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-cossette-texte: Clean and punchy overall. Gugi's tall lowercase and open terminals meet Cossette Texte, a sans-serif with wide-eyed e shapes and a prominent x-height, and the strongest quality is how readily one hands off to the other.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-duru-sans: Gugi runs its bars at an identical thickness across the line, with tall lowercase and open-cut terminals. Yet Duru Sans lets its wide, dominant small letters carry the text while its ascenders hardly show, so the heading gets the spotlight.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-fresca: Gugi brings tall lowercase letters, open-cut terminals and curves that match its stems exactly, all in a display voice. Fresca, a plain sans with connected counters, keeps pace.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-funnel-sans: Tall, bold and a little showy, Gugi has curves that match its stems and terminals cut wide open. Funnel Sans, a clean sans, works as the steady counterpart, while Gugi earns its keep big and short.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-gafata: Gafata reads as a tall band of lowercase with short stalks above, each e wide-eyed and open. Gugi, with round letters as heavy-walled as its straight ones, makes the strongest quality of this pairing the bold step down to a plain sans.
